channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, LatAm, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, LatAm, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: Tilting Axis Fellowship 2027 for Caribbean-Based Practitioners (with Nieuwe Instituut)
item.description: Tilting Axis, with Nieuwe Instituut, Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam, Fresh Milk (Barbados), RAA! (Aruba) and Instituto Buena Bista (Curacao) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,500 stipend per fellow, plus up to EUR 1,000 travel budget for research-related movement and full coverage of airfare and Netherlands programming during the visit. No application fee.
